en: Hehehe, how you doin' mon. You gonna help Pele'keiki great deal he be thinkin'. We be needin' a bombastic amount of the firebloom herb to be preparin' right for the Ahn'Qiraj War. The Horde, they say, 'Pele'keiki, you get us $2051w of the fire petals right quick'.$B$BPele'keiki tell you now, he only have $2050w firebloom, but you gonna add to that real soon, right mon?
%s is now armed!
Troublesome whelps. I'll teach you to interfere!
The Scourge are at the entrance to the Royal Quarter!  Kill them!!
Fandral! Your time has come! Go and hide in the Emerald Dream and pray we never find you!
Everywhere I look I see thieves.  We, The People's Miltia, must return this land to the farmers.
%s whinnies.
I call your true name, Azrethoc. Show your visage to me!
Huzzah for the tipper!  Step right up and get your delicious, cold drinks right here!
I'm jumpy as it is... and people insist on scaring me... Next time, though, I'll be ready!
Patrol the front line, soldiers!
Take note of the delicacy of the plagued dragon's diet.  Only terrified flesh will suffice.
What are Darkmoon Cards?
Die, outlander!

The Windshapers are almost wholly to blame for everything that has happened. Their refusal to change has damaged our ability to save ourselves from our current peril. They speak in absolutes and treat assumptions and superstitious hope as fact.

Do you know who else deals only absolutes? The Al'Aketh. 

I for one do not intend to let blind adherence to dangerous beliefs doom our people. If it weren't for the threat of the cult, I'd march our mages over to the other side of Valnaar and wipe the Windshapers out.
Elder High Mountain is at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
The Fostwolf Graveyard is owned by the Horde.

Though I hate to admit it, the bear did get the better of me. My oh my, that's one big ol' bear!$b$bNonetheless, if you can take that bear down, it'd be a feat to be proud of! It gave more than a few of our best hunters some trouble.$b$b<He claps you on the back.>$b$bBest the bear and we'll accept you as a regular member of the Farstrider Lodge.
To hunt a beast, one must know that beast.  One must learn and respect its ways.$B$BTo do otherwise is not to hunt.  To do otherwise is merely to kill.
As members of the Horde, we must contribute to our community to ensure that it continues to thrive. Thus, I am certain you will gladly aid us by undertaking a small task I have for you.
Happy Hallow's End, $c!
Corbett, dear.  Harlan needs a load of knitted shirts and pants as soon as we can manage.
Mushrooms always grow in damp places and so they look like umbrellas.
The plans for my twenty-foot tall turkey baster are nearly complete! Now all I need is a twenty-foot tall turkey...
Darrowshire!  You are doomed!

<Volcor doesn't look at you at all as you get close to him. He seems to be concentrating on keeping his bandages from falling off. After a moment, he looks up at you, a little startled.>$B$BOh, sorry, $c. Now's not a good time. I hope you understand.
Pathetic fool!  Now I will teach you the meaning of pain!

You know I do, mortal; I am abandoning a fair number of pretenses here, and I recommend you do the same.$B$BYou have come here clearly because you know that what you possess, garnered from your actions within the Sunken Temple of the Atal'al, has brought you to me for a purpose.  This purpose is to put my associate... my brother, to rest.  He is trapped within a nightmare within the Dream itself.  He cannot break free alone.
Understood. I will return shortly.
So what brings you to Light's Hope?
Watch your step out there.  Many an adventure seeker has not returned from the marsh.  hic!
%s goes into a rage after seeing his raptor fall in battle!
Get them my prettys...and their little dogs too!
Lexlort, I lost the thorium shackles.
Ye have some skill about ye with hammer and anvil, but not enough. Go speak to Dane Lindgren, he'll get ye ready to learn what I have to teach ye.
It is dangerous here, master. But I shall help stand guard.

Welcome! Step right up, don't be shy. This here is my pride and joy... the Blastenheimer 5000 Ultra Cannon! Ain't she pretty? You look a little big around the mid section, but I think you'll fit. Flying is so much fun, want to learn how?
